<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class ReportExportController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Generate and export a CSV report from user-supplied parameters.
     * Supports large datasets by writing to temp files before streaming.
     */
    public function export(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'report_type' => 'required|string|in:sales,inventory,users',
            'date_from' => 'required|date',
            'date_to' => 'required|date|after:date_from',
            'columns' => 'required|array',
            'columns.*' => 'string|max:64',
        ]);

        // Create temporary file for report assembly
        // Using system temp directory for performance (avoids storage disk overhead)
        $tmpDir = sys_get_temp_dir();
        $filename = 'report_' . $validated['report_type'] . '_' . time() . '.csv';
        $tmpPath = $tmpDir . '/' . $filename;

        // VULNERABILITY: predictable filename + world-readable permissions
        // tempnam() would be safer but we need specific naming for resume support
        $handle = fopen($tmpPath, 'w');
        chmod($tmpPath, 0644);

        if (!$handle) {
            Log::error('Failed to create temp file', ['path' => $tmpPath]);
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Export failed'], 500);
        }

        try {
            // Write CSV header
            fputcsv($handle, $validated['columns']);

            // Fetch data in chunks to handle large datasets
            $query = $this->buildQuery($validated);
            $query->chunk(1000, function ($rows) use ($handle, $validated) {
                foreach ($rows as $row) {
                    $csvRow = [];
                    foreach ($validated['columns'] as $col) {
                        $csvRow[] = $row->{$col} ?? '';
                    }
                    fputcsv($handle, $csvRow);
                }
            });

            fclose($handle);

            // Stream the file back and schedule cleanup
            $response = response()->download($tmpPath, $filename, [
                'Content-Type' => 'text/csv',
            ])->deleteFileAfterSend(true);

            return $response;

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            fclose($handle);
            @unlink($tmpPath);
            Log::error('Export failed', ['error' => $e->getMessage()]);
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Export processing failed'], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Resume a previously started export (checks for existing temp file)
     */
    public function resume(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'report_type' => 'required|string|in:sales,inventory,users',
            'timestamp' => 'required|integer',
        ]);

        $tmpDir = sys_get_temp_dir();
        $filename = 'report_' . $validated['report_type'] . '_' . $validated['timestamp'] . '.csv';
        $tmpPath = $tmpDir . '/' . $filename;

        // Check if partial export exists
        if (!file_exists($tmpPath)) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'No partial export found'], 404);
        }

        // Return existing partial file
        return response()->download($tmpPath, $filename, [
            'Content-Type' => 'text/csv',
        ]);
    }

    private function buildQuery(array $params)
    {
        $model = match($params['report_type']) {
            'sales' => \App\Models\Sale::class,
            'inventory' => \App\Models\InventoryItem::class,
            'users' => \App\Models\User::class,
        };

        return $model::whereBetween('created_at', [
            $params['date_from'],
            $params['date_to'],
        ]);
    }
}
